node.title: Re: Re \x {} junk
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I just posted this 2d ago

There is a reply to [id://11127610|that node] with links to similar threads. And in one of those threads I wrote [id://11127006|this]: Could you post a representative sample of your input file, following the advice given [id://1233709|here] and [id://11118322|here]? In particular, show us a representative sample of your input using [man://hexdump|hexdump -C file] or [man://od|od -tx1c file], pasted here inside tags.

If you don't show us your actual data, we will be left guessing, and you won't get any good answers. Please help us to help you. See also [id://174051], [id://510718], and [id://1177642].
